title: Credit Union Mergers
review_errors: Hartford Business Journal 'Expanding East Hartford credit union seeks 10th merger' (Nov 25) still can't be opened (client error); America's First Network CU's new partner still isn't public (not on NCUA's list, CT DOB merger page shows no proposed activity, the Nov 20 DOB bulletin isn't in search results)
WebFetch only opened pages that came back as search results; trade-press listing pages (Banking Dive's credit-union page is a stale 2024 copy) weren't usable, so the sweep relied on WebSearch

Logos still missing for 19 small or merged organizations: their sites now redirect to the acquirer (UKCU, Home FCU, KEMBA, Garden Savings, Bienestar, Interra, West-Aircomm), show no logo (Lynn Firemen's, Plains FCU), sit behind Cloudflare (Baker Hughes FCU) or don't exist; the Internet Archive isn't reachable from here
